check_status.description: Check whether WazirX is trading normally or under maintenance, how quickly it is answering, whether its futures market is reachable, and how far its clock is from this one. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it - skip a report, wait, or say the figures are stale - rather than dying halfway through.
check_status.name: check_status

get_futures_order_book.description: See the buy and sell orders waiting on one futures contract, best price first, with a running total of the quantity at each level, the best bid and ask, the spread and the mid price. WazirX serves the top 20 levels on each side.
get_futures_order_book.display_str_template: Get the WazirX futures order book for {0}.
get_futures_order_book.name: get_futures_order_book

parameters.description: Which contract's order book to read.
parameters.name: contract

get_futures_price.description: Get what one futures contract is trading at: the last price and its 24-hour range, change and volume, plus the mark price WazirX values positions at, the index price it tracks, how far apart the two are, and the funding rate with the time it is next charged. The funding rate is a fraction: 0.0001 is 0.01%, and 'funding_rate_percent' gives it as a percentage.
get_futures_price.display_str_template: Get the WazirX futures price for {0}.
get_futures_price.name: get_futures_price

parameters.description: Which contract to price.
parameters.name: contract

get_futures_price_history.description: Get a futures contract's price as candles - open, high, low, close and volume for each minute, hour, day or week. Each candle says whether its period has closed. An hour with no trades comes back as a flat candle at the previous close with a volume of 0, so check the volume before reading a quiet candle as a price that held.
get_futures_price_history.display_str_template: Get WazirX futures price history for {0}.
get_futures_price_history.name: get_futures_price_history

parameters.description: Which contract's history to read.
parameters.name: contract

parameters.description: How much time each candle covers.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: How many candles to return: the most recent ones, or the first ones after 'Start from' when that is set.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only candles from this moment onwards. Leave it empty for the most recent ones, which is what a chart or a running average wants.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Only candles up to this moment. Use it with 'Start from' to read a fixed window, such as yesterday.
parameters.name: until

get_order_book.description: See the buy and sell orders waiting on one market, best price first, with a running total of the quantity at each level - what it would really cost to buy or sell a given size, rather than what the last trade happened to go for. Also returns the best bid and ask, the spread and the mid price.
get_order_book.display_str_template: Get the WazirX order book for {0}.
get_order_book.name: get_order_book

parameters.description: Which market's order book to read.
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: How many price levels to return on each side. WazirX offers these sizes only.
parameters.name: depth

get_price.description: Get what one market is trading at right now: the last price, the best bid and ask, and the last 24 hours' open, high, low, change and volume. This is the action for a price alert, a morning summary or a figure to drop into a message. To price several markets at once, use 'List prices', which costs one request however many it covers.
get_price.name: get_price

parameters.description: Which market to price.
parameters.name: market

get_price_history.description: Get a market's price as candles - the open, high, low and close of each minute, hour, day or week, with its volume - for charting, a moving average, or comparing today against last month. The most recent candle is usually still forming, so each one says whether its period has closed: read 'complete' before treating a candle as settled.
get_price_history.name: get_price_history

parameters.description: Which market's history to read.
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: How much time each candle covers.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: How many candles to return: the most recent ones, or the first ones after 'Start from' when that is set.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only candles from this moment onwards. Leave it empty for the most recent ones, which is what a chart or a running average wants.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Only candles up to this moment. Use it with 'Start from' to read a fixed window, such as yesterday.
parameters.name: until

list_futures_contracts.description: List the contracts on WazirX's futures market and their terms: the maximum leverage, the smallest and largest order, the minimum order value, the price band a limit order must sit in, and the maintenance margin at each leverage tier. Pick contracts to see only those.
list_futures_contracts.name: list_futures_contracts

parameters.description: Which contracts to describe. Leave it empty for every contract.
parameters.name: contracts

parameters.description: How many contracts to return, alphabetically.
parameters.name: limit

list_futures_prices.description: Get prices, mark prices and funding rates for many futures contracts at once - the ones you pick or every contract - and rank them by turnover, by the biggest 24-hour movers, or by funding rate, highest or lowest first. Two requests cover the whole market, so this is the action for a funding-rate watchlist or a daily futures summary.
list_futures_prices.name: list_futures_prices

parameters.description: Which contracts to price. Leave it empty for every contract.
parameters.name: contracts

parameters.description: How to order the contracts.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: How many contracts to return, from the top of the order.
parameters.name: limit

list_markets.description: List the spot markets WazirX trades - BTC/INR, ETH/USDT and the rest - with each one's status, the order types it takes, its price step and its precision. Narrow it to the markets priced in one currency, such as INR, or to one coin. Useful for checking whether WazirX lists a coin, or for feeding every INR market into a later step.
list_markets.name: list_markets

parameters.description: Only markets priced in this currency. Leave it empty for every market.
parameters.name: quote_asset

parameters.description: Only markets whose name contains this, such as 'btc' or 'SOL'. Leave it empty for every market.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Also list markets WazirX has stopped trading. Off by default, so the list is what can be traded today.
parameters.name: include_suspended

parameters.description: How many markets to return, alphabetically.
parameters.name: limit

list_prices.description: Get prices for many markets in one request: the markets you pick, every market priced in one currency, or the whole exchange. Rank them by what changed hands (turnover), by the biggest gainers or losers over 24 hours, or alphabetically - the action behind a daily top-movers report or a watchlist. Turnover is the 24-hour volume times the last price, in the currency the market is priced in, so compare it between markets priced in the same currency.
list_prices.name: list_prices

parameters.description: Which markets to price. Leave it empty to price every market, or every market priced in the currency below.
parameters.name: markets

parameters.description: Only markets priced in this currency, such as INR. Leave it empty for every currency.
parameters.name: quote_asset

parameters.description: How to order the markets.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: How many markets to return, from the top of the order.
parameters.name: limit

list_recent_trades.description: List a market's latest trades, newest first: the price, the quantity, the value and whether the buyer or the seller crossed the spread to make it happen. Also counts the buys and sells and works out the average price they traded at.
list_recent_trades.name: list_recent_trades

parameters.description: Which market's trades to list.
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: How many of the most recent trades to return.
parameters.name: limit

description: Read the public market data of WazirX, the Indian crypto exchange. Get a live price for any of its markets, rank the whole exchange by turnover or by the day's biggest movers, pull candles for a chart or a moving average, look into the order book, follow recent trades, and check the exchange is up before relying on the figures. WazirX's perpetual futures are here too: contract terms, prices, mark and index prices, funding rates, candles and order books. No API key, no account and no sign-up - and every action reads, so nothing can reach an account or move money.
